statement: The existing sigmoid output is treated as an uncalibrated model score until calibration is empirically evaluated.

protocol.cv: 5-fold StratifiedKFold OOF on validation for unbiased val estimates

parameters.representation: LogisticRegression on logit(clip(p)) scalar; p_cal = sigmoid(a*logit(p)+b)

temperature.method: minimize val NLL over T in [0.05, 10] (scipy minimize_scalar, bounded)
temperature.logit_source: submodel to layers[-2].output (Dense 128) plus frozen final Dense kernel/bias (Wx+b); no weight changes
temperature.test_logit_source: logit(clip(stored test prob_fire)); no test inference recompute

isotonic.warning: n=275 is small for isotonic; in-sample val gains are optimistic — use cv_oof; do not select on test.
